name: Pagination
description: A compound pagination component for navigating multi-page content. Composed of Pagination (nav wrapper), PaginationContent (list), PaginationItem (list item), PaginationLink (page link), PaginationPrevious, PaginationNext, and PaginationEllipsis sub-components. Uses Button variants for link styling.

props.name: Pagination (nav)
props.description: Root nav element with role="navigation" and aria-label="pagination". Accepts className and all nav attributes.

props.name: PaginationContent
props.description: An unordered list (ul) that wraps PaginationItem elements. Accepts ref and className.

props.name: PaginationItem
props.description: A list item (li) wrapper for each pagination element. Adds cursor-pointer styling.

props.name: PaginationLink.isActive
props.description: When true, renders the link with the "outline" button variant and sets aria-current="page". Otherwise uses the "ghost" variant.

props.name: PaginationLink.size
props.description: The button size variant applied to the anchor element.

props.name: PaginationPrevious
props.description: Renders a left-chevron icon with optional children text. Automatically uses size="sm" when children are provided, size="icon" otherwise.

props.name: PaginationNext
props.description: Renders a right-chevron icon with optional children text. Automatically uses size="sm" when children are provided, size="icon" otherwise.

props.name: PaginationEllipsis
props.description: A non-interactive ellipsis indicator (MoreHorizontal icon) with aria-hidden and a sr-only "More pages" label.

accessibility.role: The root Pagination renders a <nav> element with role="navigation".
accessibility.keyboard: Standard anchor keyboard navigation: Tab to focus links, Enter to activate.
accessibility.aria: aria-label="pagination" on the nav. PaginationLink uses aria-current="page" when isActive is true. PaginationPrevious has aria-label="Go to previous page". PaginationNext has aria-label="Go to next page". PaginationEllipsis uses aria-hidden with a sr-only "More pages" text.
accessibility.notes: Links are rendered as <a> elements styled with buttonVariants. The active page link uses the "outline" variant while inactive pages use "ghost".

examples.title: Basic pagination
examples.code:
<Pagination>
  <PaginationContent>
    <PaginationItem>
      <PaginationPrevious href="#" />
    </PaginationItem>
    <PaginationItem>
      <PaginationLink href="#" isActive>1</PaginationLink>
    </PaginationItem>
    <PaginationItem>
      <PaginationLink href="#">2</PaginationLink>
    </PaginationItem>
    <PaginationItem>
      <PaginationLink href="#">3</PaginationLink>
    </PaginationItem>
    <PaginationItem>
      <PaginationEllipsis />
    </PaginationItem>
    <PaginationItem>
      <PaginationNext href="#" />
    </PaginationItem>
  </PaginationContent>
</Pagination>
